data.name: Darsita
data.gender_notes: Darsita is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: That which is longed for, cherished, or desired. In Hindu mythology, Darsita may refer to the beloved deity or person who brings happiness and fulfillment. The name Darsita carries the meaning “Desired, Wished For” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Darsita usually hope their child will grow to embody desired, wished for and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Name of Goddess Darsana, symbolizing the desire to see and be near the divine.
data.etymology: Darsita belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Desired, Wished For.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Darsita total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Darsita holds beauty and significance in Hindu culture as it symbolizes the longing and the deep connection towards a deity or a beloved person who brings joy and contentment. It also highlights the value of having deep desire and longing in life, as it is believed that this can lead to immense fulfillment.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, the name Darsita holds great significance as it represents the divine love and connection towards the ultimate reality or God. It highlights the importance of having a deep yearning and longing for the divine, which can lead to spiritual growth, peace, and enlightenment. Ultimately, the name Darsita reminds us of the importance of having a deep devotion towards the divine, and the joy and fulfillment that comes from this connection.
